critical_code_review_comments: GrnDetail.jsx had classic React hook-order violation: useState(sampled) declared after `if (!grn) return …`. Any file that early-returns based on a fetched state MUST declare all useState/useEffect at the top of the function body. Consider adding an ESLint rule 'react-hooks/rules-of-hooks' if not already enforced — this bug would have been caught at lint time.

rca of the issue: React error #310 (hook count mismatch) on every GRN detail open: GrnDetail.jsx declared useState(sampled) AFTER an early `if (!grn) return <ErrorBox/>`. First render (grn=null) took the early return → only 3 hooks + 2 effects registered. After the useEffect fetch resolved, grn became truthy, the component proceeded past the early return and hit `const [sampled, setSampled] = useState(false)` → hook count went from 5 to 6 → React invariant violation → ErrorBoundary. Reproduction: log in, ?view=goods-receipts&entity=ent_ksc, click any KSC/GRN card. Fix: hoisted `const [sampled, setSampled] = useState(false);` to the top hook block alongside the other useState calls, above the early return. Verified: GRN-00009 detail now renders fully with all data-testid selectors and photo displayed landscape after auto-rotate.
